৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English Wizard.question:
Transform into Complex (1-6)
১) An uninterrupted network connection is desired by all.
English Wizard.option1: ক) A network connection which is uninterrupted is desired by all.
English Wizard.option2: খ) A network connection when is uninterrupted is desired by all.
English Wizard.option3: গ) A network connection which uninterrupts is desired by all.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) A network connection which was uninterrupted is desired by all.
English Wizard.exp:
সকল প্রশ্নের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় কিছু কমন জিনিস প্রথমে আলোচনা করে নিচ্ছি।

Technique: Transformation এর জন্য বাক্যগুলোকে আদর (ADR) করতে হবে। ADR = Add, Deduct & Retain

1. Add the key-word of the targetted sentence
2. Deduct the key-word of the given sentence
3. One of the two clauses have to be retained i.e., to be kept unchanged.

Key-words:
Complex: এভাবে মনে রাখুন IT WAS SATIS (If, Though, WH Words, As, Since, So … that, As soon as, That, In order that, So that, এছাড়া এ রকম অর্থবোধক অন্যান্য Conjunction

Compound: and, or, but, yet (তবেুও), for (কারণ)

Simple: by, without, in case of, in spite of, despite, after, on, at, because of, for, to, in order to, too… to, এছাড়া অন্য যে কোন Preposition, অথবা no preposition, no conjunction

Simple এর মধ্যে কেবল একটি Clause থাকবে।
Complex ও Compound এ কমপক্ষে ২টি Clause থাকবে।
------------
Noun এর আগে Adjective থাকলে এবং ঐ Adjective টাই যদি Focused point হয়, তাহলে Complex Sentence এ Noun+ Relative Pronoun (who, which, that etc.) + be verb+ Adjective বসে।
An uninterrupted network connection = A network connection which is uninterrupted.

English Wizard.question: ২) He left the job to start afresh.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He left the job so that he could start afresh.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He left the job in order to he could start afresh.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He left the job so that he can start afresh.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He left the job so that he would start afresh.
English Wizard.exp: to+verb দিয়ে উদ্দেশ্য বুঝালে Complex Sentence এ so that/ in order that + sub + can/ may + verb এর base form বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৩) I cannot foretell the time of his departure.
English Wizard.option1: ক) I cannot foretell when he will depart.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I cannot foretell when he departs.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I cannot foretell since he will depart.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I cannot foretell while he will depart.
English Wizard.exp:
Simple Sentence এ time সম্পর্কে বলা হলে Complex Sentence এ when বসে।
foretell মানে ভবিষ্যদ্বাণী করা। এ হিসেবে পরের অংশ Future tense হবে।

English Wizard.question: ৪) In case of his failure, you have to compensate for the loss.
English Wizard.option1: ক) If you fail, you have to compensate for the loss.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If he fail, you have to compensate for the loss.
English Wizard.option3: গ) If he fails, you have to compensate for the loss.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) If you failed, you have to compensate for the loss.
English Wizard.exp:
Simple Sentence এ in case of থাকলে Complex Sentence এ if বসে।
আর মূল Clause টি Future/ Present হলে If যুক্ত Clause টি Present Tense হয়।

English Wizard.question: ৫) But for her instigation, he would not have killed the king.
English Wizard.option1: ক) Though she instigated him, he would not have killed the king.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If she had not instigated him, he would not have killed the king.
English Wizard.option3: গ) If she did not instigate him, he would not have killed the king.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) If she not instigated him, he would not have killed the king.
English Wizard.exp:
but for = without
Simple Sentence এ without থাকলে Complex Sentence এ if not/ unless বসে।
ব্যতিক্রমধর্মী কোন Preposition বা Conjunction থাকলে প্রথমে চেষ্টা করবেন, কোনো Common Preposition বা Conjunction এর সাথে এর মিল পাওয়া যায় কি না।

English Wizard.question: ৬) This tree is too high for me to climb.
English Wizard.option1: ক) This tree is so high for me to climb.
English Wizard.option2: খ) This tree is so high that I cannot climb.
English Wizard.option3: গ) This tree is high enough that I cannot climb.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) This tree is enough high that I cannot climb.
English Wizard.exp: Simple Sentence এ too …. to থাকলে Complex Sentence এ so….. that +sub+ cannot বসে।

English Wizard.question:
Transform into simple: (7-10)
৭) He said that he was innocent.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He declared to be his innocence.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He declared his innocence.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He declared to his innocence.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He declared to be innocent.
English Wizard.exp: এখানে say- verb টিকে অবস্থার চাহিদা অনুযায়ী declare এ রূপান্তরিত হবে এবং that যুক্ত clause টিকে একটি phrase এ রূপান্তর করতে হবে।

English Wizard.question: ৮) If he does not abide by the rules, the authority will punish him.
English Wizard.option1: ক) In case of his not abiding by the rules, the authority will punish him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Without abiding by the rules, the authority will punish him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Without abiding by the rules, he will be punished by the authority.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) By not abiding by the rules, he will be punished by the authority.
English Wizard.exp:
If এর পরিবর্তে negative বাক্যে in case of not/ without বসাতে হয়।
কিন্তু উভয় Clause এর Subject ভিন্ন হলে in case of + Possessive form of Subject + not +verb +ing বসাতে হয়।
খ ও ঘ ভুল Possessive form of Subject না থাকার কারণে।
in case of not= না করলে (এমনটি ঘটলে )
without = করা ছাড়া (কাজের অস্তিত্ব না থাকায়)
by not = না করার দ্বারা
গ তে Passive voice এর মাধ্যমে উভয় অংশে Subject এক বানালেও অর্থের দিক থেকে অসঙ্গতিপূর্ণ।

English Wizard.question: ৯) He is so strong that he can carry the load easily.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He is too strong to carry the load easily.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He is strong enough to carry the load easily.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He is enough strong to carry the load easily.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He is strong enough for carry the load easily.
English Wizard.exp:
so… that এর শেষের Clause Affirmative হলে Simple Sentence এ enough + noun + to +verb
অথবা Adjective + enough +to + verb বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১০) As soon as I recalled her name, he became furious.
English Wizard.option1: ক) On my recalling her name, he became furious.
English Wizard.option2: খ) At my recalling her name, he became furious.
English Wizard.option3: গ) In my recalling her name, he became furious.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) While my recalling her name, he became furious.
English Wizard.exp: Complex Sentence এ as soon as থাকলে Simple Sentence এ on বসে।

English Wizard.question:
১১) Transform into compound: (11-14)
He prospered in life by working hard.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He prospered in life and worked hard.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He worked hard but prospered in life.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He worked hard and prospered in life.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He worked hard or prospered in life.
English Wizard.exp:
কাজের গতি একই দিকে হলে Compound Sentence এ and ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
Compound Sentence এ অবশ্যই কাজের ধারাবাহিকতা অনুযায়ী Clause গুলো বসাতে হয়। Simple এবং Complex এ এটা Maintain না করলেও হয়। এ হিসেবে এখানে আগে কাজ, পরে উন্নতির কথা আসবে।
আর Compound Sentence এ উভয় Clause এ Subject একই হলে ২য় Clause এ Subject উল্লেখ করার প্রয়োজন নেই।

English Wizard.question: ১২) Despite his sincerity, he could not reach his goal.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He is sincere but he could not reach his goal.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Though he was sincere but he could not reach his goal.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He was sincere but he could not reach his goal.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He was sincere and he could not reach his goal.
English Wizard.exp:
In spite of/ despite এর পরিবর্তে Compound Sentence এ but বসে।
বিপরীতধর্মী অবস্থা হলে Compound Sentence এ but বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) He wants to earn more money.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He has a desire and it is to earn more money.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He wants so that he can earn more money.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He wants in order that he can earn more money.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He wants and it is to earn more money.
English Wizard.exp:
কিছু কিছু বাক্য নির্দিষ্ট Structure এর মাধ্যমে Transformation করা যায় না।
অর্থ সঙ্গতি এবং প্রথমে বর্ণিত Basic নিয়ম ঠিক আছে কি না, এ দুদিকে লক্ষ্য রেখে সঠিক উত্তর বাছাই করতে হবে।
এসব ক্ষেত্রে সঠিক উত্তর না খুঁজে বরং Minus Three Theory বা ভুল অপশনগুলো বাদ দেয়ার প্রক্রিয়া অনুসরণ করা ভালো।
খ ও গ Complex Sentence. তাই ভুল।
এখানে ঘ অপশনে wants Transitive Verb হওয়ায় Object না থাকার কারণে বাক্য incomplete হয়ে যাচ্ছে।
ক গঠনগত ও অর্থগতভাবে শুদ্ধ। তাই সঠিক উত্তর ক।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) The weather being very cold, nobody was outside the home.
English Wizard.option1: ক) The weather was very cold and nobody was outside the home.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The weather is very cold and so nobody was outside the home.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The weather was very cold but nobody was outside the home.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) As the weather was very cold, nobody was outside the home.
English Wizard.exp: ”কারণ ও ফলাফল” বুঝানোর কারণে and বসবে।

English Wizard.question:
Transform into Simple: (15-17)
১৫) He went out and I woke up.
English Wizard.option1: ক) After his going out, I woke up.
English Wizard.option2: খ) On his going out and I woke up.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Since his going out, I woke up.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) At his going out, I woke up.
English Wizard.exp:
সময়ের পর্যায়ক্রম বুঝানোর জন্য সাধারণত after বসে।
একই সময়ে বুঝাতে at বসে।
ঠিক পরপরই বুঝাতে on বসে।
since অর্থ থেকে।

English Wizard.question: ১৬) He was a thief and the police arrested him.
English Wizard.option1: ক) Being a thief, the police arrested him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Because of a thief, the police arrested him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Because of his being a thief, the police arrested him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) In spite of his being a thief, the police arrested him.
English Wizard.exp:
দুটি clause এর subject ভিন্ন হলে simple sentence এর জন্য পরিবর্তিত phrase এর গঠন হবে:
Preposition + Possessive form of subject + verb+ing/Noun.
এখানে কারণ বুঝানোর জন্য Preposition – because of বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৭) I saw a boy and he was playing in the field.
English Wizard.option1: ক) I saw a boy playing in the field.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I saw a boy to play in the field.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I saw a boy to playing in the field.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I saw a boy while playing in the field.
English Wizard.exp: Simple Sentence এ see+ obj+ verb+ing/ verb এর base form বসে।

English Wizard.question:
Transform into Compound: (18-21)
১৮) Unless you try heart and soul, you cannot become a success.
English Wizard.option1: ক) You try heart and soul or you cannot become a success.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Try heart and soul or you cannot become a success.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Don’t try heart and soul and you cannot become a success.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Try heart and soul or you can become a success.
English Wizard.exp:
Unless থাকলে unless যুক্ত clause কে Imperative sentence এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হবে।
conjunction হিসেবে or বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৯) The old man was punished as he killed the bird.
English Wizard.option1: ক) The old man killed the bird and was punished.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The old man was punished and killed the bird.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The old man was killed the bird and was punished.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The old man killed the bird but he was punished.
English Wizard.exp: “কারণ ও ফলাফল” কাজের ধারাবাহিকতা অনুযায়ী Clause গুলো বসবে এবং Conjunction হিসেবে and বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ২০) He was so poor that he could not buy his daily bread.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He was very poor but he could not buy his daily bread.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He was very poor and could not buy his daily bread.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He was so poor and he could not buy his daily bread.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He was too poor and he could not buy his daily bread.
English Wizard.exp: so… that থাকলে Compound Sentence এ very….and বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ২১) Della had an ardent desire so that she could give her husband a worthy gift.
English Wizard.option1: ক) Della had an ardent desire and she could give her husband a worthy gift.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Della had an ardent desire and so she could give her husband a worthy gift.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Della had an ardent desire and gave her husband a worthy gift.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Della had an ardent desire and it was to give her husband a worthy gift.
English Wizard.exp:
so that থাকলে “উদ্দেশ্য ও কাজ” এ ধারাবাহিকতা অনুযায়ী Clause গুলো বসবে।
উদ্দেশ্য বুঝানোর জন্য want, aim, wish ইত্যাদি verb উদ্দেশ্য বর্ণনাকারী clause এর মধ্যে যোগ করতে হবে।

English Wizard.question:
Transform into Complex: (22-25)
২২) He was poor, yet he retained his integrity.
English Wizard.option1: ক) Though he was poor, he retained his integrity.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Though he retained his integrity, he was poor.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Though he was poor, he could retain his integrity.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Though he was poor, but he retained his integrity.
English Wizard.exp: but/ yet এর পরিবর্তে Complex Sentence এ though/ although বসে।

English Wizard.question: ২৩) Search his pockets and you will find the watch.
English Wizard.option1: ক) If search his pockets, you will find the watch.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If you search his pockets, you will find the watch.
English Wizard.option3: গ) If he searches his pockets, you will find the watch.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Unless you search his pockets, you will find the watch.
English Wizard.exp: প্রথম clause Imperative Sentence হলে Complex Sentence এ if বসে।

English Wizard.question: ২৪) He saw the danger and paused.
English Wizard.option1: ক) When he saw the danger, he paused.
English Wizard.option2: খ) When he paused, he saw the danger.
English Wizard.option3: গ) If he saw the danger, he paused.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Though he saw the danger, he paused.
English Wizard.exp: সময় বুঝানোর কারণে Complex Sentence এ when যোগ হবে।

English Wizard.question: ২৫) He aimed at gaining my favour and started eulogizing me.
English Wizard.option1: ক) When he aimed at gaining my favour, he started eulogizing me.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He started eulogizing me so that he might gain my favour.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He started eulogizing me in order to he might gain my favour.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He started eulogizing me so that he aimed at gaining my favour.
English Wizard.exp: এটি ২১ নং প্রশ্নের rule এর বিপরীত চিন্তা করলেই হবে। এখানে aim at বাদ যাবে so that বসানোর কারণে। so that এর পরে Past Tense এ could/might বসে।
